_comment: The XTX machine (docs/REFERENCE-MACHINES.md). Values that differ from OpenCore's Sample.plist, by stage. Each stage starts from the one named in 'inherits' and adds to it. SMBIOS serials are NOT here: build.py reads them from ~/.config/vermilion/smbios-<machine>.json.
name: ASUS ROG STRIX B650E-I + Ryzen 9 7900X3D + RX 7900 XTX
_default_stage: The everyday EFI, built and installed when --stage is not given. vermilion-trust since EFI change 7 (2026-11-22 23:45); what is booted now: docs/PROJECT_KNOWLEDGE.md. The vermilion stage (amfi=0x80, no VermilionTrust) stays as the fallback.
_acpi: SSDT-CPUR: the firmware declares CPUs only as ACPI0007 devices; macOS needs Processor () objects (24, matching the MADT's enabled IDs). See the table's header.
_dsdt_fix: Replacing the DSDT with a recompiled, resolved copy (fix_dsdt.py resolve) loaded cleanly but did not get past the CoreAnalyticsHub hang (third boot, 2026-11-18). Replaced by in-place NOP patches below, the method proven on other ASUS AM5 boards (nullmoth/1401 issue 21).
_acpi_patches_bios: The BIOS version the DSDT patches below were derived for. build.py refuses a DSDT dump of another version, and, under Linux booted directly, a firmware of another version.

acpi_patches.comment: DSDT BIOS 4005 line 12901 @0x0ED92: unconditional chipset PCIe tree (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1)); 26/26 devices present under Linux
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 13497 @0x0F812: unconditional chipset xHCI + ports (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1 && G004 != 0x43FA1022)); 18/18 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15053 @0x10E80: unconditional DP20.NV00 (If (... && G002 != 5)); 1/1 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15079 @0x10EE3: unconditional DP00.NV00 (If (... && G002 != 6)); 1/1 present
DSDT BIOS 4005 line 15461 @0x113C2: unconditional DP40.EP00 (If (G002 != 3 && G000 == 1 && G002 != 4 && G003 == 0)); 1/1 present

_acpi_patches: Each Find is an If header (opcode A0, PkgLength, predicate) in the firmware DSDT, replaced by the same number of NOPs (A3): the block body then runs while the table loads, as on Linux. The blocks are the ones whose devices all exist under Linux on BIOS 4005 (fix_dsdt.py resolve plan). build.py checks each Find occurs exactly once in the dumped DSDT. Re-derive after a BIOS update.

booter_quirks._DisableVariableWrite: Ryzen 7000/8000/9000 boards hang when the macOS installer writes firmware variables (freeze at ~12-19 minutes remaining, 2026-11-19). Fix from nullmoth/1401 docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md and issue 21.
booter_quirks._ResizeAppleGpuBars: 0 = macOS sees the GPU BARs at their default sizes (BAR0 256 MiB) while Resizable BAR stays on in the BIOS for Linux. Vermilion maps BAR0 as a VRAM window and was validated with 256 MiB (src/vermilion-boot/phx_core.cpp). OpenCore 1.0.8 accepts only -1 or 0 here.

kernel_patches.comment: Pike R. Alpha | AGDP board-id -> board-ix (agdpmod=pikera without WhateverGreen) | 26+

_kernel_patches: Navi (RDNA) cards need agdpmod=pikera or they hang/black-screen when the graphics stack takes over (stall after 'IOG flags 0x3 (0x51)', 2026-11-19). WhateverGreen breaks on macOS 26 (Dortania Tahoe page), so this is the same rename as a kernel patch, exactly as nullmoth/1401 p1401/policy.py PIKERA_PATCH does for AMD dGPUs on Tahoe.
_uefi_drivers: --preserve-boot: the picker's Reset NVRAM keeps the firmware boot entries (Limine, OpenCore). Without it a reset wiped them all on 2026-11-18.

install._comment: Phase 1 first boot and the macOS install: the fewest kexts that boot, SIP on, verbose.

base._comment: Phase 1 after the install: Wi-Fi, then the rest of the machine, one change per boot. Wi-Fi: AirportMtkWlan 2.1.6 loaded but never attached to the card (boot 1, 2026-11-19); MtkWirelessWifi 1.1.1 since then (findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md).
base._kexts_add: USBToolBox 1.2.0 + UTBMap (efi/kexts/UTBMap.kext): the USB map, added 2026-11-22 (findings/2026-11-22-usb-map.md). macOS never created the chipset ports of the USB audio (11) and Bluetooth (16): the firmware's _UPC marks them not connectable, or the controller's 17 ports exceed macOS's 15 (which one is unproven, 2026-11-23); USBToolBox detaches the ACPI ports and builds each controller's ports from the map instead.
base._SMCProcessorAMD: macos86/SMCProcessorAMD 1.0.1, added 2026-11-22 (findings/2026-11-22-cpu-sensors.md): the CPU temperature (SMN 0x59800 through the host bridge's index/data pair, as Linux k10temp), package power (RAPL energy MSR) and core clocks (P-state status MSR) as VirtualSMC keys. It only reads (binary checked: no wrmsr, one config write = the SMN index). AMDRyzenCPUPowerManagement was rejected: it replaces the kernel's CPU power management and rewrites a P-state definition MSR; its Tahoe fork also polls the GPU's registers.
base._Bluetooth: BlueToolFixup 2.7.2 + MtkWirelessBT 1.1.1 + the two NVRAM variables below, added 2026-11-22 (findings/2026-11-22-bluetooth.md): the MT7922's Bluetooth (USB 0489:e0e2, matched by MtkWirelessBT's own list) gets its firmware, and bluetoothd stops assuming Apple's Broadcom module. MtkWirelessBT documents 26.7.1 25G241 x86_64 as tested.
base._boot_args_add: pci=0x8000000 = kIOPCIConfiguratorDefaultETF (IOPCIFamily-726 IOPCIConfigurator.h): macOS keeps the firmware's extended/10-bit tag settings. Without it IOPCIBridge::probeBusGated sets 10-Bit Tag Requester Enable on the GPP7 root port (Linux leaves it off), and the MT7922 and I225-V, the only chipset endpoints without 10-bit tag completer support, stop answering (2026-11-19, findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md). AMD_Vanilla's 'Disable 10 bit tags' patch is enabled but the bit was set anyway. amtk_awdl_offchan=0 (MtkWireless WIFI.md): AWDL stays on the AP's channel while associated. Without it the radio left channel 52 for ~400 ms every ~1.05 s (AWDL slots on 44 / 6), router ping 100 ms avg / 456 ms max vs 1.8 / 5 ms with awdl0 down (2026-11-22, findings/2026-11-22-audio-connectivity-inventory.md). Cost per the docs: AirDrop to phones whose AWDL is on another channel fails.

vermilion._comment: Phase 2: Vermilion (docs/INSTALL.md section 1). Needs build/VermilionBoot.kext from the macOS build host. Inherited install from 2026-11-19 (GPU first, Wi-Fi untested); re-parented onto base on 2026-11-19 for the Wi-Fi test, so the booted stage gets AirportMtkWlan and nothing else changes.

vermilion-trustlog._comment: Thread 05, step 1 of replacing amfi=0x80 (decisions 2026-11-22): vermilion + VermilionTrust in log-only mode. amfi=0x80 stays, so AMFI still allows everything and nothing can be refused; the kext only reports, in the kernel log and in sysctl debug.phxtrust_stat, that its hooks are installed and which ad-hoc code each process maps. One boot, then back to vermilion or on to the enforcing stage.

vermilion-trust._comment: Thread 05, step 2 of replacing amfi=0x80 (decisions 2026-11-22): vermilion + VermilionTrust enforcing, amfi=0x80 removed. AMFI checks library validation and signatures for every process again; VermilionTrust lets only the cdhashes of the installed Vermilion code through (debug.phxtrust_files lists overrides and every refused file). ipc_control_port_options=0 stays for this boot (one change at a time). Log-only boots of the kext: vermilion-trustlog (1.0.0 and 1.0.1, 2026-11-22, desktop unchanged).

vermilion-trust-nvram._comment: Thread 01 (2026-11-23): vermilion-trust with NVRAM writes from macOS allowed (DisableVariableWrite off), nothing else changed. DisableVariableWrite was set against the installer's hang on Ryzen 7000 boards (machine booter_quirks above); its cost: no kernel panic log in NVRAM (so no panic report, OpenCore ApplePanic has nothing to save), no startup-disk change, and phxfb-squat can't be cleared from macOS (the b138 squat loop, findings/2026-11-20-b138-freeze-and-squat-loop.md). Whether runtime writes hang this board too is what this stage tests: sudo nvram vermilion-test=1, read it back, restart. With writes working the squatter's one-boot arming is real again: the daemon re-arms phxfb-squat only while ~/gpu/phxboot-auto exists. Rollback: EFI/OC.prev (change 8).

vermilion-trust-bar1g._comment: Thread 02 part C, step 1 of CPU-visible VRAM (decisions 2026-11-23): vermilion-trust with BAR0 resized to 1 GiB for macOS instead of 256 MiB (OpenCore Booter quirk ResizeAppleGpuBars 10: 2^10 MB, Apple's documented maximum; OpenCore picks the largest supported size up to it). VermilionBoot maps at most kFbAperMapMax of it and places nothing new there yet; this boot only proves macOS takes the 1 GiB BAR. ocvalidate calls any value but 0 'unstable with macOS sleep-wake'; sleep has no resume path on this machine anyway, so that one message is accepted (ocvalidate_accept).
ocvalidate_accept: Booter->Quirks->ResizeAppleGpuBars is set to 10, which is unstable with macOS sleep-wake!

vermilion-trust-bar1g-audio._comment: Thread 04 (2026-11-24), DP / HDMI audio step 1: vermilion-trust-bar1g + VermilionAudio (a Lilu plugin that, when AppleGFXHDA loads, rewrites its controller table entry 1002:ab20 to the RX 7900's 1002:ab30; findings/2026-11-23-dp-hdmi-audio-inventory.md). Inert at boot: AppleGFXHDA loads only when the daemon adds the ab30 personality (tools/phxctl/audio_match.sh), after the GPU bring-up. Check: sysctl debug.phxaudio_stat. Rollback: EFI/OC.prev.
vermilion-trust-bar1g-audio._uefi_drivers_remove: Phase 2 item 1 (2026-11-24; not built or booted yet, unverified): no Reset NVRAM entry in the picker. Reset NVRAM deletes phxfb-squat, which macOS can't set again (DisableVariableWrite), so every later boot falls back to the firmware display (CLAUDE.md hard rule 1). Without the driver the picker has no entry and OpenCore has no reset. Check after the boot: the picker shows no Reset NVRAM, /var/log/phxboot.log still says 'squat boot ...: 1'. Rollback: EFI/OC.prev.

vermilion-trust-bar1g-audio-sse._comment: Plan A7 (2026-11-26; installed on the XTX machine as EFI change 40, not booted yet, unverified): vermilion-trust-bar1g-audio + RyzentoshSSE (ownback/ryzentosh-sse 0.1.0). passd looks for the AppleSSE service a T2 Mac has; without it passd retries 60 times, 0.5 s apart, and Music's first launch waits about 30 s on accountsd (findings/2026-11-25-music-slow-load.md, findings/2026-11-25-passd-secure-element.md). The kext publishes AppleSSE and answers every call 'not supported'. It is meant to replace the local.phxpassd login agent, which stays installed until this stage has booted and passed the check. Check after the boot: ioreg -c AppleSSE shows one service; no 'AppleSSE service not found, retrying' lines from passd after login; Music's first launch is fast with local.phxpassd removed. Rollback: EFI/OC.prev.

vermilion-pcilog._comment: Diagnostics, one boot at a time: vermilion + IOPCIFamily's own logging (pci_log_mode 0x6 = IOLog + os_log, which also prints 'config protect fail'; pci_log 0x677 = AER, init, power, config, state, interrupt, enumeration, life cycle). Logging only, no behaviour change. Added 2026-11-19 because the MT7922 and the I225-V get an empty capability list (findings/2026-11-19-wifi-mt7922.md).
